title: Bees settle arguments by headbutting
topic: How a honeybee swarm reaches a decision about a new nest site by silencing rival dancers rather than persuading them
voice_script: Honeybees settle arguments by headbutting each other. When a swarm needs a new home, scouts fly out and come back dancing the directions to the sites they found. Rival scouts do not argue with them. They walk up and deliver a short vibrating headbutt. Each hit makes the dancer stop, and enough hits silence her completely. The bees are not voting for a winner. Nobody persuades anybody. They are switching off everyone else until only one dance is left.
